validation.notes: Board https://github.com/users/quantumquirkxyz/projects/27 is linked to quantumquirkxyz/WorkBridge with 17 fields and 14 items. Status has exactly the six ADR-0021 values (Backlog, Ready, In Progress, Review, Blocked, Done) and no Phase field exists. Fields are Status, Priority, Size, Sprint, Risk plus native milestone, labels, assignees, reviewers, parent issue, sub-issue progress and linked pull requests. Five views read back with filters: Planning (wayfinder:* and spec), Execution Board (excludes planning artifacts, board layout), Blocked (status:Blocked), Review (status:Review), Roadmap (excludes planning artifacts, roadmap layout). README verification: gh project view returns the rewritten README. Lint, typecheck, 867 tests and coverage thresholds all pass.

riskRemaining: The Execution Board groups by Status and the API cannot set grouping or sorting, so a human must confirm the board layout in the GitHub UI; automation rules remain unconfigured by design. The repo docs now point at project 27, but ADR-0021 is still only on the unmerged local branch chore/governance-index, so the docs describe the board without citing that ADR.
